errors.error_description: Used a level-sensitive asynchronous reset in a sequential block with "always @ (posedge clk or rst_n)" instead of using an edge on the reset, improperly mixing async reset semantics with synchronous logic.
Introduced a deeply nested if-else chain in the EXEC state to determine next-state and data operations, creating a long combinational path that is suboptimal for synthesis.
Connected a 10-bit signal to an 8-bit submodule port, causing a port width mismatch and implicit truncation at the module boundary.
